target_customer: Enterprises in finance, healthcare and legal deploying AI agents, plus developers needing agent authentication
problem: Agents rely on shared API keys and overbroad service accounts; companies lack per-agent identity, scoped permissions, approvals and audit logs.
business_model: Enterprise SaaS for agent identity and governance, plus a developer integration hub; pricing not found
product_category: AI agent identity and access management

founders.name: Paulina Xu
education: MIT (AI and Physics), dropped out before second year
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: research at MIT Kavli Institute, MIT Haystack Observatory and INAF Padua.

founders.name: Matthew Xu
education: MIT (AI and Math), dropped out at 19
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: research at MIT FutureTech Lab and MIT CSAIL.

competitors.name: Astrix Security
competitors.traction_then: established startup; sources say Cisco acquired it in 2026

technical_complexity.rationale: Identity, policy and audit across many integrations is standard enterprise engineering; two student founders built it fast.

defensibility.rationale: Identity layers can lock in once integrated, but Okta, Microsoft Entra and funded startups are all moving in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents added agent identity features in 2025 and 2026 and a rival was reportedly acquired by Cisco.

market_need_then: Enterprises began deploying agents in 2025 and security teams raised shadow AI and credential sprawl concerns; the YC launch post of November 2025 pitched it as Okta for agents.

identity.logo: Fabriq logo with white and color variants per site
identity.visual_style: Minimal layout with classic landscape paintings and numbered sections

branding.brand_signature: Classic painting imagery and the pitch 'Okta for agents'

brand_strength.rationale: Distinctive imagery, but the name is confused with Fabrix Security and Fabriq (UK SaaS) in search.

outcome_analysis: Active with two founders in YC Winter 2026. No outcome yet; it must outrun incumbents and funded startups in agent identity. Claims of 500+ agents governed and a first paying customer are unverified.
notes: Caplight and PitchBook show $500K (Caplight dates a seed 2025-06-15, PitchBook last deal 2026-04-21), crunchbase says pre-seed; aggregators only, so no round recorded. The $8M Fabrix Security seed is a different company. Outcome search found no acquisition or shutdown.
